findings.evidence: The command exceeds 200 lines despite splitting templates and assembly implementations into a bundled skill. Detailed attachment and recovery instructions remain under '### Phase 5: PR write', alongside the reference's 'Branch publish and attach recovery' recipe.
findings.fix: Move the detailed attachment-body construction and create/edit/recovery recipes into skills/pr-diagrams/references/pr-body.md. Keep the phase ordering, final size gate, terminal-failure invariant, and explicit conditional reference-loading instruction in the command; record the moves in docs/audit/recovery/explain-pr-changes/record.md.

findings.evidence: The none-mode filter uses 'while (match(rest, /!\[[^]]*\](\[[^]]*\])?/))' without distinguishing an inline image from a shortcut reference. Given '[logo]: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/example' and '![logo](https://static.example.com/logo.png)', the sed stage preserves the ordinary-host image, but the final awk removes '![logo]' because its alt text matches the diagram reference label, leaving the bare '(https://static.example.com/logo.png)'. This contradicts section 1.3's 'Never ... strip it' rule for ordinary images.
findings.fix: Update the final awk pass to recognize and preserve complete inline-image spans before resolving reference-style or shortcut images; resolve shortcut labels only when the image is not followed by an inline destination. Add this label-collision scenario with an assertion that the ordinary-host image remains byte-for-byte intact to commands/evals/explain-pr-changes.json.
